**Status:** production invention, disposable compiler calibration.

The repository gate may start or decline the compile, read its exit status and classified diagnostics, and refuse a false green; once any owed diagnostic appears, the zero-owed-diagnostic threshold is crossed and it must block publication until the relationship is repaired and the compile reruns. It cannot alter contract inventory, suppress a configured relationship, or publish a successful result after that threshold. No physical, financial, or private cost is authored; the bounded operational cost is repair and rerun, and its vulnerability is a configured relationship being silently suppressed.
